title: Out of Distribution, Out of Luck: How Well Can LLMs Trained on Vulnerability Datasets Detect Top 25 CWE Weaknesses?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating In-Distribution (ID) vs. Out-of-Distribution (OOD) generalization across different Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories to measure how models overfit to dataset-specific artifacts, class imbalances, and spurious correlations rather than learning genuine vulnerability patterns.
